KEEL_WAKE_PHASE_ORDER_METHOD_REVIEW_V1 — METHOD-PASS, implementation only with explicit conditions

Actual independent nonimplementation reviewer `/root/wake_independent_review` read and retained exact plain proposal5844B/SHA256b82f09ba4e9ddbb0035a7171fa3f3bc7233a985104798215ff97c7623f55685e before the specified phase-END event code: conservative decoder49a1d3a9cdf2e17b3f96c7f5aab7806c56563d0f0d0f1e30ca6bd4ec033ad571 and producer helperff92908884f40563217bcde499808607d98d0ff58fd852b57a26f3897192438e contain no specified marker literal. I authored no executable candidate/harness/decoder/event code and launched no games.

The existing protocol permits exact independently retained event evidence as an alternative to nonoverlapping clock bounds. The proposed SOURCE-BACKED CAUSAL order is acceptable to implement under ALL conditions below. A provider receipt timestamp is NOT a lower bound on process exit/completion; this is not a one-second grace, timestamp skew waiver, canonical image claim or historical Helm rescue.

1. Scope only the two original before-tools/prepared phases and their exact mapped provider step-completion boundaries. Direct end<=whole-second completionT remains valid. Causal fallback is eligible ONLY for a literally WHOLE-second completion field with captureEnd strictly(T,T+1s). End>=T+1 or any end later than an EXACT FRACTIONAL completion (including .0000000) cannot be rescued. Preserve exact precision; do not use datetime truncation to establish equality/order for7+digits. Exact arithmetic or explicit unsupported-precision rejection at ordering boundaries is required; raw marker timestamps can remain observations without numeric lower-bound claims. Add100ns-separated/fractional-bound corruptions.

2. Freeze the noncyclic plan before initial approval and bind its whole SHA in profile and nested runtime report, preserving20/4/10/9 outer shapes. Bind actual original snapshot bytes, workflow, real marker-emitter/helper AND raw collector closure. Explicitly define foreground-command digest bytes and map them to the exact frozen run/argv/script/env; no arbitrary self-reported command hash. No source/plan/profile/output self-hash cycle.

3. Independently fetched original current run/attempt/head/numeric-job API must identify the exact completed-success capture step and exact completed-success later registered next step. Reviewed source must prove capture/validation/snapshot-write, ONE exact marker, then FOREGROUND return before next step. Reject shell background/detach, workflow background/parallel, reordered/replaced/skipped/failed/missing steps and source mismatches. Greater numeric step IDs alone are insufficient. GitHub explicitly supports background/parallel steps; the required ordinary foreground sequence is a source-reviewed constraint. [Official workflow syntax](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#jobsjob_idstepsbackground).

4. Final COMPLETE ORIGINAL same-job provider log must contain exactly one full unescaped expected prefix+canonical6field marker for each declared phase, bound to stage/phase/run/attempt1/head/snapshotSHA and actual capture-step scope before next-step source segment. Freeze exact step/command/log-boundary mapping, strict message-hash newline convention and1-based full-log ordinal. Quoted code, echo-only text, duplicates, later replays, partial/extracted logs and historical workers are invalid. Marker UTC is retained as an observation, never reinterpreted as physical completion time.

5. Pregame full-log unavailability is restricted to the ALREADY allowed correctly bound current in-progress HTTP404 with independent run/jobs/artifact access. Exact reviewed source/jobs/raw-snapshot graph facts may then give ONLY the explicit source-and-jobs-graph-pending-final-marker qualification; disclose that the provider marker has NOT been observed. No403/auth/network/wrong-job/truncated-or-contradictory200 or missing-fact fallback. If an available full log is used, required unique scoped markers must verify. No silent expansion of the header deferral or claim of completed external proof.

6. Mandatory independent final completed provider API/log/plan/source/marker/step-graph reconciliation precedes overall validity, confirmation or adoption, even when initial qualified review allowed games. Any missing/ambiguous/contradictory proof means PROVENANCE-INCOMPLETE; raw scores/physical budget preserved with no reruns/replacements. Known exact clock contradictions still fail. Final proof and actual independent reviewer sidecar/report remain noncyclic and truthfully attributed; no machine/default-author reviewer fiction.

7. Actual unmocked whole-reader screen AND fresh-confirmation no-engine fixtures must exercise the12 proposed corruption families plus exact fractional/100ns, command-hash and workflow background/parallel cases. No engine/server/bot.start/opponent process/full-battle simulation or extra gameplay fixture. Required ordinary Java17 pure planner/physics semantic tests remain allowed. All earlier conservative source and failures remain preserved.

METHOD-PASS authorizes IMPLEMENTING this alternative with those constraints, not claiming any implementation already satisfies them. Final exact DATA/source/code/enforcement/CI/freeze and active independent same-worker runtime admission remain CLOSED before the fixed120-round screen. Conditional300fresh confirmation still requires every original screen gate and complete final provenance/raw review. No numerical gate, population, seed, baseline/AIS byte, budget or original21registration payload changes. No competitive Wake outcome exists; monitor remains PAUSED.

Detailed stopped method report8635B/SHA2561f5d18584b69ec50adea8ea9b9c84a942a8429ccdccd5356b7d500e42c5d5a3f;3payload+selfmanifest SHA25613a921cf7f5ceda57a99fb4b569d8c1df6b3ec947ac69232ce90a30eef64a5eb.
